cover.alt: An amber inspection lamp lights a miniature hinged car door, landscape and portrait film frames, and a clapperboard with sound-wave pulses, beside the headline Reuse the Method. Check the Result.
cover.headline: REUSE THE METHOD. CHECK THE RESULT.
cover.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original landscape editorial blog cover, approximately16:9, for Framewright Studio Notes issue03. Exact English headline in large high-contrast ivory type: "REUSE THE METHOD. CHECK THE RESULT." Exact smaller series label: "FRAMEWRIGHT STUDIO NOTES 03". Restrained charcoal, deep teal and warm amber visual family. Sophisticated tactile miniature film-production workbench, not a software screenshot: three connected reusable modules represented by a hinged miniature car door on a precise pivot, two film-frame apertures in landscape and portrait, and a clapperboard aligned with two short sound-wave pulses on a strip. A small amber inspection light ties them together. Main illustrated arrangement on left half; headline on generous dark negative space on right, balanced and readable at480px reduced width. Convey selective control and verification rather than an assembly line claiming automatic success. Elegant editorial composition, textured paper/metal surfaces, quiet studio lighting. Only the exact headline and series label as text; no other words, logos, watermarks, fake statistics, gauges or brand characters. Original composition; no uploaded references.
